name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), 'string_resource_filename' reflects the datatype (a NUL-terminated ASCII C string used as a resource filename), and 'fdother_dat' identifies the FDOTHER.DAT archive. The trailing '_dat' is part of the on-disk filename 'FDOTHER.DAT', NOT a Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to its own address 0x51a4d or any other). Matches the sibling resource-filename strings (fdtxt_dat, fdmus_dat, tai_dat) that likewise carry no address suffix.
purpose: Read-only resource filename string "FDOTHER.DAT"; passed as the char* path (arg0) to fd2_load_dat_resource to open the misc/global resource archive FDOTHER.DAT.
logic_summary: 12-byte const char[] = {'F','D','O','T','H','E','R','.','D','A','T',0}. Address taken (array decays to char*) and handed to fd2_load_dat_resource to open FDOTHER.DAT, which holds palettes, SFX banks, cinematic sprite sheets, ending art, etc. Different callers request different archive indices: fd2_load_save_and_init_engine loads idx 0 -> vga_palette_data; many animation / cinematic / chapter-intro / ending routines (e.g. fd2_play_ending_and_record_clear, fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic, fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeB/C, fd2_load_chapter_background_layers, main) load other indices. 57 xrefs total, all reads.
element_semantics: ASCII bytes of the NUL-terminated C string "FDOTHER.DAT" (11 chars + NUL terminator). Consumed byte-wise as a char* file path by fopen(...,"rb") inside fd2_load_dat_resource.
notes: Evidence: read_memory(0x51a4d,12) = 46 44 4f 54 48 45 52 2e 44 41 54 00 = "FDOTHER.DAT\0". Ghidra DataType=string LEN=12.
